appearance.silhouette: 흰 산문양 견갑과 완장을 맞춰 찬 산채 문 앞 창병
appearance.visualIdentity: 마른 보통 체격의 성인 한국인 산채 창병. 양쪽 어깨의 흰 산문양 천 견갑 한 쌍과 screen-left 위팔 완장 하나가 문 앞 대형 방어병의 통일 표식이다.
appearance.equipmentLock: 짧은 창 정확히 1개를 screen-right 손에 세워 쥐고 screen-left 손으로 자루를 보조한다. 흰 산문양 견갑은 좌우 정확히 2개, 완장은 screen-left 위팔 정확히 1개다. 방패, 검, 활은 없다.

style.profile: ProjectBS rough low-density open-ink mok-seon pastel
style.linework: rough sparse near-black open ink contour

singleImageSpecification.pose: neutral readable full-body formation-guard stance; spear upright; head, feet, and spear tip fully visible
singleImageSpecification.framing: centered complete figure and weapon with safe empty margins; no crop

requiredElements: screen-right 주손과 screen-left 보조손으로 잡은 짧은 창 정확히 1개
prohibitedElements: 창 또는 표식 좌우 반전, 증식, 누락
서양, 일본, 중국 판타지 병사 치환
실존 역사 인물의 초상이나 군복 재현

phases: f0 grounded gate-guard ready with spear upright
f1 short stance compression while both hands retain their fixed grip roles
f2 spear lowers toward screen-right target line as pelvis and ribcage load
f3 support foot plants and torso begins controlled forward drive
f4 one decisive straight spear thrust at extended melee range, tip fully inside cell
f5 brief extension hold with no second thrust
f6 spear retracts along the same line as weight returns
f7 upright formation-ready recovery
animationRequests.motion: single controlled gate-guard spear thrust derived from the basic skill; connected foot, pelvis, torso, shoulder and two-hand shaft control; no arm-only jab or repeated attack
equipmentLocks: screen-right primary hand controls the spear and screen-left support hand remains on the shaft
exactly two white mountain-mark cloth pauldrons, one per shoulder
exactly one armband on screen-left upper arm
no shield, sword, bow, second spear, duplicated marking, or whole-body mirror
animationRequests.styleEffects: short body-attached broken black/charcoal dry-brush compression along the spear line during f3-f5 with sparse earth-tone pastel pressure at planted foot; no projectile, magic, aura, detached trail, clean vector line, or cell crossing

phases: f0 anatomical LEFT contact
f1 LEFT compression
f2 LEFT-to-RIGHT passing
f3 distinct guarded up phase
f4 anatomical RIGHT contact opposite f0
f5 RIGHT compression opposite f1
f6 RIGHT-to-LEFT passing opposite f2
f7 distinct guarded up phase closing into f0
animationRequests.motion: slow screen-right formation advance at movement scale 0.75 with measured steps, planted push-off, pelvis compression and stable upright spear control; game root fixed, no camera pan, running sprint or sliding torso
equipmentLocks: single spear remains controlled by screen-right primary hand and screen-left support hand
two marked pauldrons remain on both shoulders
single armband remains on screen-left upper arm
no grip swap, mirror, duplication, detachment, shield, sword, or bow
animationRequests.styleEffects: minimal body-attached broken ink echoes under planted steps and behind cloth edges; no attack streak, detached speed trail, floor cloud, magic, or neighboring-cell effect

phases: f0 upright formation guard
f1 shallow inhale with slight shoulder rise while spear remains vertical
f2 small grounded weight shift through hips and knees
f3 exhale as support hand settles along the shaft
f4 brief screen-right gate scan without turning or attacking
f5 pauldrons, armband and clothing settle cleanly into f0
animationRequests.motion: restrained living formation-defender idle with both feet planted and spear controlled; not an attack wind-up, march-in-place, ceremonial pose, or weapon flourish
equipmentLocks: one upright short spear with unchanged two-hand grip sides
no mirror, hand swap, duplication, disappearance, detachment, shield, sword, or bow
animationRequests.styleEffects: almost none; at most tiny body-attached broken settling marks that vanish by f5; no aura, persistent glow, floor effect, magic, or neighboring fragment

combat.roleIntent: 산채 문 앞에서 전열을 유지하고 궁수/주술 담당을 보호하는 창병

notes: 핵앤슬래시 다수 몬스터 전투 기준으로 공격 스코어 50%, 체력 스코어 25% 보정 적용. NPC 기본 회복 스탯은 사용하지 않는다.
Speed and attack speed baseline changed to 1.0; cooldowns now scale from attackSpeedScale.
